items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: with the big -- big band drummers we'd have to say that Sonny and Joe Jones were the bosses

ctx.x: The bass player has to play along with the reed section unless his arrangement is written so that he plays those dynamics with the brass, you know. But it's usually the thing, and this is what Gus and I, well, we just worked on, you know.

Now, with the big -- big band drummers we'd have to say that Sonny and Joe Jones were the bosses -- the original bosses, you know. And Krupa wasn't bad. Buddy Rich is good, but Buddy Rich was more or less an individualist, you know.
